about.metaTitle: About Aldo Tile | Tile Installer in Mississauga
about.metaDescription: Meet Aldo Tile, a Mississauga tile installer who cares about what's behind the wall as much as the finish. Learn how we plan, prepare and complete each job.
about.lead: A Mississauga tile business built on preparation, straight lines and clear communication.

story.heading: What we believe
paragraphs: Aldo Tile is built on one simple belief: good tile work is mostly decided before the first tile goes on. A shower depends on the membrane behind it. A floor depends on what's underneath it.
That belief shapes how we approach a job. We look at what the wall, floor or schedule actually needs before we talk about the finish.
We take on work for homeowners updating one room, and for contractors and property managers who need a tile trade on site. The scale changes, but the standards don't.

wayOfWorking.heading: How we work
wayOfWorking.intro: No two jobs are alike, but the steps stay the same.

steps.title: We listen and look
steps.text: You tell us what you want, and we look at the space, the structure and anything that could affect the finished result.

steps.title: You get a clear quote
steps.text: The written quote spells out what's included, what preparation is needed and when we expect to do the work.

steps.title: We plan the layout
steps.text: Before setting tile, we work out where the lines fall and where the cuts go, and we check anything important with you.

steps.title: We prepare, then install
steps.text: Waterproofing, levelling and other hidden work get the same care as the tile that everyone will see.

steps.title: We finish and clean up
steps.text: We check the work with you, explain any care it needs and leave the space ready to use.

privacy.metaDescription: A short, plain notice about what the Aldo Tile contact form collects, where your message goes, how it is used and how to ask us to delete it.
privacy.lead: This site has one form, used to contact us about tile work. Here is what happens to what you send.

sections.heading: What the form collects
paragraphs: When you send the contact form, we receive the details you enter:
list: Your email address, if you give one
Whether the project is for a home or a business

sections.heading: Where it goes
paragraphs: Your message is stored by Netlify, the company that hosts this website and runs the form, and it's emailed to Aldo Tile.
Netlify may also record technical details, such as your IP address and browser information, to manage spam.

sections.heading: How we use it
paragraphs: We use your details only to reply to you about your job. We don't add you to a mailing list, and we don't sell your details or share them for marketing.

sections.heading: Asking us to delete it
paragraphs: You can ask us to delete your message and details at any time. Email us at the address below and we'll take care of it.
